## Pull Request Description

### Summary of Changes
Provide a brief summary of the changes introduced by this pull request.

### Linked Issues
Closes # (issue number)
Resolves # (issue number)

### Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that causes existing functionality to change)
- [ ] CI/CD or Infrastructure update
- [ ] Documentation update

### Team Contributor
- Assigned Member: [Member 1 / Member 2 / Member 3 / Member 4]
- Branch: `feature/...` -> `develop`

### Verification & Testing
- [ ] Flake8 style check passes (`flake8 app tests --max-line-length=120`)
- [ ] Pytest test suite passes (`pytest tests/`)
- [ ] Code coverage maintained or increased (>= 80%)
- [ ] Manually tested on local server / Docker container
